title: RFL Skill ISA composition file
description: Validates a Skill ISA composition file (the JSON / YAML form an author writes; reference instance examples/01-cable-insertion/skill.yaml). Structural validation per 01-skill-isa.md: the compositional algebra (sequence / parallel / reactive / repeat / branch / let-bind), that every primitive call key is one of the 50 ISA primitive ids, and that an extension call is namespaced ext.<ns>.<name>. Per-primitive parameter names, types, units, and enums are NOT constrained here — a primitive's params is an open object (that precise typing is a follow-up, category by category). Backs conformance test class 1 (parser conformance, 05-conformance.md). The algebra is the abstract BNF of 01 § Compositional algebra; this schema fixes its concrete YAML serialization, where a let-bind is a sequence statement {let, from} whose binding scopes over the rest of the enclosing sequence (the BNF's explicit in(...) is accepted as an optional key).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the skill does.

body.description: The skill body: a single Composition (typically a sequence).

ObjectMap.description: Task object references, keyed by local name. Each entry names an ObjectRef whose pose is resolved at runtime by a sense.* primitive (01 § Object reference).

ref.description: The object identity (ObjectRef) this local name binds to.

PrimitiveId.description: The 50 Skill ISA primitive ids, category.primitive in lowercase snake_case (01 § Provisional primitive enumeration). The enumeration is closed; extension primitives use the ext.<ns>.<name> form instead.

Params.description: A primitive's parameter block. Structurally an open object (or absent / null for a param-less call); the param names, value types, units, and enums of each primitive are intentionally not constrained at this level (deferred to the per-category fully-typed schema).

Composition.description: A node of the compositional algebra (01 § Compositional algebra). Exactly one of: a primitive call, an extension call, or one of the combinators sequence / parallel / reactive / repeat / branch / let-bind. The forms are disjoint by key namespace, so a well-formed node matches exactly one.

PrimitiveCall.description: A core primitive invocation: a single key that is a PrimitiveId, mapping to its params (BNF Primitive ::= PrimitiveId "(" ParamList? ")").

ExtensionCall.description: An extension primitive invocation (BNF Extension ::= "ext" "." Identifier "." Identifier ...). The id is ext.<namespace>.<name>; the registry (06-extension-registry.md) owns the namespace, not this schema.

Sequence.description: Ordered composition: each child runs to completion before the next (BNF Sequence). A let-bind child binds a name visible to the children that follow it in the same sequence.

Parallel.description: Concurrent composition of two or more branches (BNF Parallel).

Reactive.description: Run a body until a predicate confirms true (BNF Reactive ::= "reactive" "(" Composition "," "until" "(" Predicate ")" ")"). Per 01 § three-valued control flow the body terminates only on a confident true; a concurrent envelope violation takes precedence over a clean until completion.

Repeat.description: Repeat a body a fixed count or until satisfied (BNF Repeat ::= "repeat" "(" Composition "," Count ")", Count ::= Integer | "until_satisfied").

Branch.description: Three-valued conditional (BNF Branch). then / else are taken on a confident true / false; the optional unknown arm is taken on indeterminate, and without it an indeterminate predicate escalates rather than guessing (01 § three-valued control flow).

LetBind.description: Hoist a planner-derived value (typically a sense.* result) for reuse (BNF LetBind ::= "let" "(" Identifier ":=" Expression ")" "in" "(" Composition ")"). Concrete YAML form: a {let, from} statement whose binding scopes over the rest of the enclosing sequence; the BNF's explicit in(...) is accepted as the optional in key. Downstream uncertainty / measured-value flow checks are owned by 01 § LetBind flow checks, not this schema.

let.description: The bound identifier; later primitives reference its value by name.

from.description: The expression whose result is bound (typically a sense.* primitive call).

in.description: Optional explicit scope (BNF in(...)); omitted when the binding scopes over the rest of the enclosing sequence.

Predicate.description: A predicate of the algebra (BNF Predicate), consumed by reactive (until) and branch. A single key naming the predicate kind, mapping to its (here unconstrained) argument. value / confidence / evidence verdict semantics are owned by 01 § Predicates, verdicts, and three-valued control flow.
